description: Which backtests have I run? Lists the backtest runs belonging to the authenticated user — newest first, with id, strategy, pair, interval, date range and headline metrics per run. Use it to find a run_id, then call arena_get_backtest for its detail or arena_get_backtest_trades for the individual trades. Only your OWN runs; for the public cross-user leaderboard use arena_get_winners. Paginated via limit + offset. [API Pro tier]

asset_type.description: Filter by asset class, e.g. 'crypto'. Omit for all.

interval.description: Filter by candle interval; omit for all. Candle interval: '1d' daily, '2d'/'3d' multi-day, '1w' weekly, '1M' monthly. Multi-day candles (2d/3d) are anchored to the Unix epoch, so one of n possible alignments is used. Measured on our own corpus, the choice of alignment alone moves CAGR by 6.66 pp on average (max 12.30). Treat differences below that as not distinguishable — 1d/2d/3d behaved as one block in our tests, not a ranking.

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging; default 0.

pair.description: Filter by pair symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT. Omit for all.

strategy.description: Filter by strategy key, e.g. 'rsi_sma'. Omit for all.

name: arena_list_backtests
title: List Your Backtests
